insights.topic: Verified purchase data vs. probabilistic targeting
insights.insight: Cryptographically verified receipts — 106,322 confirmed transactions totaling $5.09M cumulative GMV — represent deterministic purchase proof, not behavioral inference. Brands paying $5+ CPM for cookie-based targeting are buying probability; this data sells confirmed outcomes.

insights.topic: Grocery dominance with premium signal in Unknown category
insights.insight: Grocery-supermarkets leads at 28.3% of 14-day receipts (1,211 receipts, $53,202), but the Unknown category commands an $87.76 average ticket versus $43.93 for grocery — nearly double — and this premium has held across every observed snapshot, suggesting a high-value purchaser segment not yet fully classified.

Walmart (315 receipts), Kroger (143), and Costco (120) together account for roughly 28% of 14-day verified transactions, giving CPG and consumer brand advertisers a direct view into competitive basket share at named retail accounts — not modeled, counted.

insights.topic: Vertical expansion: logistics and financial services now confirmed
insights.insight: The UPS Store entered the thresholded brand list on 2026-11-22 and Chase has held its position across multiple cycles — meaning verified receipt coverage has expanded beyond grocery and retail into shipping/logistics and financial services, broadening the audience segments a marketer can reach with purchase-confirmed targeting.

insights.topic: Geographic diffusion pattern: pulse-based, not burst
insights.insight: Metro coverage has grown to 19 active CBSA cells, with each new cell appearing as a single addition rather than in clusters — a controlled, methodical expansion pattern that signals deliberate rollout rather than viral growth, with implications for how quickly national-scale audience coverage can be projected.

insights.topic: Restaurants and dining confirmed as durable category
insights.insight: Restaurants-dining first appeared in the 14-day aggregate on 2026-11-20 and has since stabilized at 847 receipts and $26,745 — nearly matching retail-department-stores in GMV — confirming that out-of-home food spend is now a structurally present signal, relevant for QSR, beverage, and loyalty marketers.
